s1.title: 1. Overview
s1.p1: Likha Poha AI ("we", "us", or "our") offers AI-powered educational services for CBSE students in Grades 5–12. This Refund Policy explains when and how refunds are issued for subscription fees paid on our platform at <0>www.likhapoha.in</0>.
s1.p2: By subscribing to any paid plan, you agree to this Refund Policy. Please read it carefully before making a purchase.

s2.title: 2. Subscription Plans
s2.intro: Likha Poha AI currently offers the following paid plans:
items: <0>Premium</0> — ₹299 / month (single student, all CBSE subjects Grades 5–12)
<0>Family Premium</0> — ₹499 / month (up to 2 students, all CBSE subjects Grades 5–12)
<0>Extended plans</0> — 6-month and annual options are available through special offer codes; the same refund terms below apply.
s2.freeTier: A <0>Free Tier</0> with limited access is available at no cost and requires no payment.
s2.closing: All paid plans provide full access to AI lessons, Ask Doubt, Mock Tests, Exemplar Research & Lessons, Formula & Concepts library, 10 years of Board Papers with answers, Learn More video library, Exam Prep Centre (JEE / NEET / CUET / SAT / IELTS / TOEFL), and Parent Dashboard.

s3.title: 3. Refund Eligibility
items: <0>Within 24 hours of first purchase:</0> If you have not used the platform (no lessons generated, no doubts asked, no mock tests taken, no Board Papers viewed), you may request a full refund by writing to <1>{{email}}</1>.
<0>After 24 hours:</0> Subscriptions are <1>non-refundable</1> once the billing period has started and platform features have been accessed.
<0>Cancellation:</0> If you wish to cancel, please do so before your next renewal date. Cancellation stops future charges but does not entitle you to a refund for the current paid period.

<0>Platform outage:</0> If a verified technical failure on our platform prevented you from accessing paid features for a significant portion of your billing period, we will assess each case individually and may issue a prorated credit or refund.

s4.title: 4. How to Request a Refund
s4.intro: To request a refund, email us at <0>{{email}}</0> with:
items: Your registered email address or username
The plan you subscribed to and the date of purchase
A brief reason for the refund request
s4.closing: We aim to respond within <0>2 business days</0>. Approved refunds are processed within <1>5–7 business days</1> to the original payment method.

s5.title: 5. Non-Refundable Situations
s5.intro: Refunds will <0>not</0> be issued in the following cases:
items: The platform was used (lessons generated, doubts asked, tests taken, or Board Papers viewed)
The refund request is made after the 24-hour eligible window
Account suspension or termination due to a violation of our Terms of Service
Dissatisfaction due to AI-generated content quality — we encourage exploring the Free Tier to evaluate the platform before upgrading

s6.title: 6. Disputed or Fraudulent Transactions
s6.body: If you believe an unauthorised charge was made to your account, contact us immediately at <0>{{email}}</0>. We will investigate and resolve legitimate disputes as quickly as possible.

s7.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
s7.body: We may update this Refund Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

s1.p2: These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you (the user) and Likha Poha AI, India.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.intro: Likha Poha AI provides AI-powered educational tools for CBSE students in Grades 5–12, including:
items: AI-generated step-by-step lessons aligned to the NCERT curriculum
Ask Doubt — conversational AI answers to student questions
Mock Tests — customisable CBSE practice tests with 140,000+ questions
Exemplar Research & Lessons — NCERT Exemplar-level deep-dive for Science and Maths
Formula & Concepts library — chapter-wise formula sheets with worked examples
Board Papers — 10 years of past CBSE board exam papers with full AI-generated answers
Learn More — curated video resources per chapter
Exam Prep Centre — preparation resources for JEE, NEET, CUET, SAT, IELTS, and TOEFL
Parent Dashboard — progress monitoring, alerts, and family account management
Mobile app — companion Android and iOS app for on-the-go learning
s2.closing: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any feature of the Platform at any time with reasonable notice.

s3.title: 3. Eligibility and Accounts
items1: The Platform is designed for students in Grades 5–12 (approximately ages 10–18).
Users under 18 must have parental consent. Parents/guardians are responsible for their child's use of the Platform.
You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account.
s3.item2_0: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials.
s3.item2_1: You must notify us immediately at <0>{{email}}</0> if you suspect unauthorised access to your account.
s3.item2_2: Sharing your account credentials with others is not permitted.
s3.sub3Body: Each person may maintain only one active account. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent usage limits or subscription restrictions is prohibited.

s4.title: 4. Subscriptions and Payments
s4.sub1Body: Likha Poha AI offers a free tier and the following paid plans: <0>Premium</0> (₹299/month, single student) and <1>Family Premium</1> (₹499/month, up to 2 students). Extended 6-month and annual plans are available through special offer codes. The Free Tier provides limited access at no cost. Full plan details are on the <2>Pricing page</2>.
items2: Payments are processed by Razorpay, a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway.
All amounts are in Indian Rupees (INR) and inclusive of applicable taxes.
Subscriptions do not auto-renew — you choose to extend when your plan expires.
s4.sub3Body: Please refer to our <0>Refund Policy</0> for details on eligibility, timelines, and the refund process.

s5.title: 5. Acceptable Use
s5.intro: You agree to use the Platform only for lawful educational purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You must not:
items: Use the Platform to generate, store, or share content that is harmful, abusive, defamatory, or illegal.
Attempt to reverse-engineer, copy, scrape, or harvest content, lesson data, or question banks from the Platform.
Use automated scripts, bots, or crawlers to access the Platform without our written permission.
Attempt to bypass subscription limits, rate limits, or access controls.
Upload or transmit malicious code, viruses, or any software designed to disrupt the Platform.
Impersonate another user, teacher, or administrator.
Use the Platform for commercial tutoring services or reselling AI-generated content without our written consent.
s5.closing: Violation of these rules may result in immediate account suspension without refund.

s6.title: 6. AI-Generated Content Disclaimer
s6.intro: Likha Poha AI uses large language models to generate educational content. While we work to ensure quality and curriculum alignment:
s6.item0: AI-generated lessons, answers, and explanations may occasionally contain errors, inaccuracies, or outdated information.
s6.item1: Content should be used as a <0>supplementary learning aid</0>, not as a substitute for verified textbooks, teachers, or official NCERT materials.
s6.item2: For competitive exams (JEE, NEET, CUET, SAT, IELTS, TOEFL) or high-stakes assessments, always verify answers with authoritative sources.
s6.item3: We continuously improve content quality through human review and AI model upgrades.

s7.sub1Body: All platform design, code, branding, lesson templates, question banks, and AI model configurations are the intellectual property of Likha Poha AI. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without prior written permission.
s7.sub2Body: Lesson topics and chapter names are based on the publicly available NCERT curriculum published by the Government of India. We acknowledge NCERT's role in shaping the Indian educational framework.
s7.sub3Body: Any content you submit (e.g. doubt questions, feedback) grants us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use it to improve the Platform. We will not identify you personally in any such use.

s1.title: 1. Who We Are
s1.p1: Likha Poha AI ("we", "us", or "our") is an AI-powered educational platform for CBSE students in Grades 5–12, accessible at <0>www.likhapoha.in</0>. A companion mobile app is also available for Android and iOS.
s1.p2: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and your rights regarding that data. By using our platform you agree to the practices described here.

s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
items1: Password (stored as a bcrypt hash — we never store plain-text passwords)
s2.item3_0: Razorpay order ID and payment ID
s2.item3_1: Subscription plan selected and payment status
s2.item3_2: We do <0>not</0> store card numbers, CVV, or bank details — all payment processing is handled by Razorpay.
items4: IP address and browser user-agent (for security logging)
On the mobile app: device type, OS version, and app version (no precise location or contacts accessed)

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
items: <0>Deliver the service</0> — generate AI lessons, answer doubts, create mock tests personalised to your grade and curriculum.
<0>Account management</0> — create and manage your account, process subscriptions, and send transactional emails (welcome, password reset, receipt).
<0>Improve the platform</0> — analyse aggregated usage patterns to improve lesson quality, model performance, and UI/UX.
<0>Safety and fraud prevention</0> — detect abuse, enforce rate limits, and protect platform integrity.
<0>Legal compliance</0> — maintain records as required by Indian law (IT Act 2000, IT Rules 2021).
s3.closing: We do <0>not</0> sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for marketing.

s5.title: 5. AI Providers and Third-Party Services
s5.intro: Likha Poha AI uses AI language model providers (OpenAI, Groq, Google Gemini, Cerebras, SambaNova, Anthropic, Ollama Cloud) to generate lesson content. Prompts sent to these providers contain:
items: Grade, subject, chapter, and topic
The student's question (for Ask Doubt)
s5.mid: Prompts do <0>not</0> contain names, email addresses, or other personally identifiable information. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these providers:
vendors: <0>Supabase</0> — database and authentication (data stored in secure cloud infrastructure)

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
items: Account data is retained for as long as your account is active.
AI usage logs are retained for 12 months for platform analytics and then deleted.
Payment records are retained for 7 years as required by Indian tax and financial laws.
On account deletion, all personal data is removed within 30 days except where legally required to be retained.

s7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
s7.intro: Likha Poha AI is designed for students in Grades 5–12 (approximately ages 10–18). We take children's privacy seriously:
items: Student accounts are created by parents or guardians via the Family Account system, or directly by school administrators.
We do not show advertisements to students.
We do not collect more data than necessary for delivering the educational service.
Parents may request deletion of their child's account and data at any time by contacting us.

s8.title: 8. Cookies and Local Storage
s8.intro: We use browser local storage (not third-party cookies) to:
items: Maintain your login session (JWT token)
Remember your dark/light mode preference
Cache recently viewed lesson content for faster loading
s8.closing: We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking pixels.

s9.title: 9. Your Rights (PDPB / IT Act)
s9.intro: Under Indian data protection law and our commitments, you have the right to:
items: <0>Access</0> — request a copy of the data we hold about you.
<0>Correction</0> — update incorrect or incomplete data via your profile settings.
<0>Deletion</0> — request deletion of your account and associated data.
<0>Portability</0> — request an export of your usage data in a structured format.
<0>Withdraw consent</0> — you may stop using the service at any time.
s9.closing: To exercise any right, write to us at <0>{{email}}</0>. We will respond within 30 days.

s10.title: 10. Data Security
items: All data in transit is encrypted via TLS 1.2+.
Passwords are hashed using bcrypt (never stored in plain text).
API keys and secrets are stored as environment variables or in encrypted Supabase columns — never in source code.
Admin access requires multi-layer authentication.
We conduct periodic security reviews of our infrastructure.
s10.closing: No system is perfectly secure. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly to <0>{{email}}</0>.

s11.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. When we do, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top and, for material changes, notify you via email or an in-app notice. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
